_comment: #264 task 0.2: TOPIC-002 403 baseline, captured against the PRE-change handler. Originally never regenerate or edit. #263 deliberately hand-edited the two bodies to add the `code` member (the reason name) after `category`, so this is no longer a pre-change baseline; it is the independent statement of the current contract. Still never regenerate it from the handler (that would be circular); change it only by hand and deliberately. The correlationId is random per response, so the body is stored with that one value replaced by the placeholder.

NOT_A_FACILITATOR.body: {"error":{"category":"forbidden","code":"NOT_A_FACILITATOR","message":"Only a facilitator or an application admin can view this team's topic list.","correlationId":"<correlationId>"}}

FACILITATOR_IS_TEAM_MEMBER.body: {"error":{"category":"forbidden","code":"FACILITATOR_IS_TEAM_MEMBER","message":"A facilitator cannot view topic management for a team they are a member of.","correlationId":"<correlationId>"}}
